title: Terminal-Bench-LILT: Multilingual Agentic Coding Benchmark Grounded in Language, Region, and Culture
abstract: arXiv:2608.28641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most evaluations for coding agents are conducted exclusively in English, which does not reflect real-world multilingual deployment. We present Terminal-Bench-LILT, a suite of 300 authentic coding tasks in ten languages: Arabic, Czech, German, Spanish, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Serbian, Turkish, and Chinese. Each task targets issues specific to non-English software development that have no direct English equivalent, e.g., internationalization, encoding, text normalization, and cultural conventions. All tasks are authored by native-speaker programmers and validated through a multi-stage quality control pipeline. Evaluation of six frontier models reveals that even the strongest model reaches only 63.1\% pass rate, with many tasks unsolved by any model. Performance varies substantially by language and does not track general coding benchmark rankings, highlighting that multilingual coding competence is a distinct and underexplored capability

translated_title: Terminal-Bench-LILT：基于语言、地区与文化的多语言智能体编程基准测试
translated_abstract: 大多数针对编程智能体的评估仅以英语进行，这并未反映现实世界中的多语言部署情况。我们提出了 Terminal-Bench-LILT，这是一套包含300个真实编程任务的基准测试，涵盖十种语言：阿拉伯语、捷克语、德语、西班牙语、印地语、日语、韩语、塞尔维亚语、土耳其语和中文。每个任务都针对非英语软件开发中特有的、没有直接英语对应的问题，例如国际化、编码、文本规范化以及文化惯例。所有任务均由母语程序员编写，并通过多阶段质量控制流程进行验证。对六个前沿模型的评估显示，即使是最强的模型也仅达到63.1%的通过率，且许多任务没有任何模型能够解决。模型性能因语言不同而有显著差异，且与通用编程基准排名并不一致，这凸显了多语言编程能力是一种独特且尚未被充分探索的能力。
tldr: 该论文提出了Terminal-Bench-LILT，一个基于语言、地区与文化构建的多语言智能体编程基准，包含十种语言的300个真实编程任务，评估发现最强模型通过率仅63.1%，且性能与通用编程基准排名不一致，揭示了多语言编程能力是独特且未被充分探索的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Terminal-Bench-LILT, a multilingual agentic coding benchmark with 300 authentic tasks in ten languages grounded in language, region, and culture, revealing that even the strongest frontier model achieves only a 63.1% pass rate, highlighting multilingual coding competence as a distinct and underexplored capability.
